chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Only a believer loves Ali, and only a disbeliever hates him.

key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Ali ibn Abi Talib, the first Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of loving Ali in Shia theology?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith articulates the core Shia doctrine of *Walayah* (divine guardianship), positing that love for Ali (AS) is not merely a virtue but an essential criterion for the validity of faith. It underscores the inseparable link between the Prophet’s authority and Ali’s, framing affection for the Ahl al-Bayt as the litmus test for distinguishing true believers from disbelievers.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-267 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, “
Only believers love Ali (a.s.) and only atheists despise him.”
